text:
Marissa: quick sync — we need a concrete sequencing plan for the prefetch-pin pilot. Product wants pilot-ready by 2026-05-10. Can runtime / infra and security fit this into the next sprint?
Arjun: I can take runtime scope: API to pin prefixes + KV cache invalidation hook. Need ETA on infra work.
Priya: infra needs the tenant isolation networking and disk reservation changes. rough estimate: 2 sprints unless we reduce scope.
Marissa: ok — what parts are must-have vs nice-to-have? we can carve a canary MVP.
Ben: must-have: simple pin API + admin ACLs. nice-to-have: per-tenant cache sizing and prewarm.
Samira: security blockers: hardware KMS flow for pinned keys and audit logging. If we rely on existing KMS integration it's small; if we need HSM certs, adds ~3 weeks.
Arjun: runtime-wise the pin API is a small surface, but safe rollout needs a fallback when prefetch fails (so callers don't get blocked). Plan: 1) implement API + metrics 2) add fallback + quota enforcement 3) perf tuning. Each step ~3-5 workdays.
Leo: SRE: need canary routing + capacity reservations in deploy pipeline. We can schedule canary window but need infra quotas first.
Priya: options: (A) full infra scope (2 sprints) or (B) minimal infra (quota for pilot only) — B cuts time to 1 sprint. Which do you prefer?
Marissa: go with B for pilot. We'll ship admin ACL + pin API + minimal infra quota. Defer per-tenant sizing to post-pilot.
Samira: confirm we can reuse current KMS path? @Priya yes/no?
Priya: yes, reuse KMS — HSM not required for pilot. Samira: good, reduces security lead time.
Arjun: timeline check: if I start now, runtime API + fallback + metrics by 04/30. Need infra quota by 04/24 for canary.
Priya: can do quota by 04/22 if we prioritize it this week. Need a PR and a brief runbook for SRE.
Leo: I’ll prep canary playbook. Will need a quick prewarm script from runtime to validate pins.
Ben: product will own canary acceptance criteria: no >1.5x tail-latency increase, no more than 2% error spike, and successful pin acknowledgements for 95% of test pins.
Marissa: excellent. Action items: 1) @Priya create infra quota PR by 04/18, mention KMS reuse. 2) @Arjun open runtime PR (pin API + fallback) by 04/20. 3) @Leo draft canary runbook + prewarm script by 04/22. 4) @Samira confirm audit logging posture in PR comments. 5) @Ben prepare acceptance test harness.
Priya: noted — I'll annotate infra PR with rollback steps.
Arjun: will include metrics + a lightweight feature flag for gradual rollout.
Samira: I'll check logging hooks; if anything missing I'll comment on the PRs.
Ben: will provide the test harness repo link when ready.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary window for 2026-04-25 02:00-04:00 UTC pending approvals.
Marissa: thanks everyone — I'll update the roadmap board and ping stakeholders. If priorities shift we can re-scope to a smaller internal-only pilot.
Leo: one small ask — include a healthcheck endpoint for pinned pages. saves troubleshooting time.
Arjun: good call, adding `/health/pinned-cache` to the scope.
Marissa: closing notes: pilot scope locked to MVP list above; follow-up async on PRs. I'll post a short summary in #product after PRs land. :thumbsup:
